description: This file defines the FindByPrimaryKey class, which implements an entity operation to find a record by primary key within the Apache OFBiz framework's mini-language. It includes methods for executing the find operation, gathering artifact info, and string representation, along with a factory class for instantiation.

classes.name: FindByPrimaryKey
classes.description: Implements an entity operation to find a record by primary key, supporting partial or full fetch with cache options.

classes.name: FindByPrimaryKeyFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of FindByPrimaryKey from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the primary key lookup using the delegator, handling cache and field selection, and stores the result in the method context.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information, specifically the entity name used in the operation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the find-by-primary-key element with its attributes.
